results.summary_before: This SystemVerilog design is a fully combinational adder for 8-bit posit numbers with zero exponent bits. It decodes the two posit operands into fixed-point values and scale factors, aligns and adds them, then re-encodes the rounded result back into posit format. Operand A is supplied on the input pins, operand B on the bidirectional pins, and the sum appears on the output pins. The design was exhaustively verified in simulation against a software reference before fabrication, and post-silicon testing is planned with a microcontroller or DIP switches.

results.summary_before: This project implements AND, NAND and OR logic on two DIP-switch inputs and shows the results on a seven-segment display. A step button or an external 10 kHz clock advances the registered logic state, and a reset button clears it. The documentation includes a full truth table and a step-by-step test procedure, making it a teaching aid for basic gates. It is a Wokwi design with no additional external hardware beyond the display and switches.
